proposition.claim:
Connectivity fractions \(c_i\in[0,1]\) and nonnegative distances define \(Q=N^{-2}\sum d_{ij}g_ig_j\), \(W=N^{-2}\sum d_{ij}g_ig_jc_ic_j\).

The paper uses \(\sum_i\min_{j\in\Omega(i)}C_{ij}\); the source instead keeps \(\min_{i,j\in G}C_{ij}\) for each interchangeable group.
